description: Stage III triple-negative breast cancer trial-match query. Exercises the trial-match surface (P5) with explicit TNBC biomarker status and BRCA testing, plus a comorbidity that affects chemo eligibility. Validates that P5's retrieval doesn't leak into lung/HN categories.
query: 55 y.o. female with stage III triple-negative invasive ductal carcinoma of the left breast, ER-/PR-/HER2- confirmed, BRCA status pending, ECOG 1, status post neoadjuvant dose-dense AC-T with residual disease at mastectomy. What are the best matching trials for adjuvant or post-neoadjuvant systemic therapy?
